acceptance_met: Outcome branch (section 6): parent SHA ee2616f1 measured on nb-connect first (5 reps, 1/6/64 partitions x live/dead-first bootstrap): mean first-ack 62.5ms at 25 fds. Targeted cost highly visible: a step-2 timing probe showed spawn_node_workers opening all 8 slots sequentially costs ~44-52ms, ~80% of first-ack. Proceeded with implementation; disposition accepted.

Per-broker version negotiation, SASL, retry policy and idempotent partition pinning preserved: slot routing is the same partition % connections mapping onto stable per-node slot indices; version check, SASL (open_conn), node-level reconnect backoff, and worker failure/remove semantics unchanged. Full suite green: 20/20 suites incl. mock_produce 7/7, network_deadlines 8/8, auth_lifecycle 32/32, client_api 101/101, produce_cancel (worker-tasks hook) pass; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt clean.

Time to first ack falls at 1 and 6 partitions (interleaved 5+5, disjoint 95% CIs): 1-part median 62305 -> 17961us (-71.2%), 6-part 61811 -> 19898us (-67.8%), 64-part 61840 -> 19368us (-68.7%). Socket count matches partitions actually used: one record uses one slot, and open fds fall 25 -> 18 at every partition count (exactly 7 fewer = the 7 unopened worker sockets; 1 meta + 1 worker + 16 runtime fds). Metadata pre-warm (nudge_leaders) removed so idle partitions never open sockets.

hypothesis: spawn_node_workers eagerly opens all connections.max(1)=8 worker sockets sequentially at node setup (~44-52ms, ~80% of nb-connect first-ack); opening only the demanded slot cuts first-ack and holds 1 worker socket for a 1-partition producer.
limits: macOS reports total fds via fcntl, not socket fds; the 25->18 delta decomposes exactly to 7 unopened worker sockets (loopback, client process only; broker is a separate child process). Linux CI will show socket fds directly.

Multi-partition first-touch ramp opens slots sequentially (~6ms each) via the single connect_loop; each partition's first ack is still strictly earlier than parent, which paid all 8 opens before any ack. Steady-state data path is untouched (same Worker, same handles once open).
Pre-warm removal means a metadata refresh no longer opens leader connections speculatively; the first send to a slot pays the open (~6ms loopback), previously sometimes hidden by the race.
